lessons.title: FSI 1 · Morning greetings
theory: Two men greet each other in the morning. Jambo works at any hour; Habari za asubuhi? asks specifically for the morning's news, and Njema answers that all is well.
Mutisya: “Habari za asubuhi?” — How are you this morning?

Source: Foreign Service Institute (U.S.), Swahili Basic Course, 1963. — Public domain (U.S. Government work). The dialogue is reproduced from the public-domain course transcript; summaries and quiz questions are original Bolingo Learn writing.

questions.prompt: Mutisya says “_____, bwana.” Which word completes his greeting?
questions.explain: Mutisya opens with “Jambo, bwana.” — Hello, sir. Habari is also a greeting, but it is not the word in this line.

questions.prompt: Which line answers “Habari za asubuhi?” in this dialogue?
questions.explain: In the dialogue, “Habari za asubuhi?” is answered by “Njema.” — Fine.
“Habari za asubuhi?” means “How are you this morning”.
